description: Attock Cement Pakistan Limited (ACPL) was established in 1981 with an initial capital outlay of Rs 1.5 billion and began commercial production in 1988 with a plant capacity of 2,000 tons per day of clinker. Through successive expansions, including a line added in FY24, it now runs four manufacturing plants at its factory in Hub, Balochistan, and sells under the Falcon brand. In April 2026, Fauji Cement Company Limited and Kot Addu Power Company Limited completed the acquisition of a majority stake in the company.
